title: Protein and antibody purification followed by immunoprecipitation of MYB and GATA zinc finger-type maize proteins with magnetic beads
protocol: Add 5 mL LB medium, 0.2% glucose, and 10 μL Ampicillin (stock 50 mg/mL) to a culture tube.
Inoculate with a single bacterial colony from the agar plate.
Culture at 37°C and shake for 16 h.
Inoculate 500 mL of rich medium glucose (0.2%) and Ampicillin (100 μg/mL) with 5 mL of a culture of cells grown for 16 h containing the fusion plasmid.
Mix well and measure the starting OD of the culture.
Measure the optical density (OD) of the culture A600 ∼ 0.5 (2 × 10^8 cells/mL).
Add IPTG to the culture to a final concentration of 1 mM and incubate at 37°C for 3 h.
Divide the induced culture into two 500 mL polypropylene bottles.
Centrifuge the culture at 4,000 × g for 20 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend pellets in 25 mL column buffer (500 mL of culture).
Add 0.1 mM PMSF and protease inhibitor cocktail to the sample.
Freeze the sample for 16 h at -20°C.
Thaw the sample in cold water.
Transfer the sample to a 50 mL Nalgene centrifuge tube and place in an ice bath.
Sonicate the sample in short pulses of 15 s.
Sonicate samples on ice using amplitude: 37, process time: 2 min, pulse on: 15 s, pulse off: 15 s, temperature monitoring and shutdown: 115°C.
Centrifuge the sample at 20,000 × g for 20 min at 4°C.
Keep the supernatant (crude extract).
Dilute the crude extract 1:2 with column buffer to a total of 50 mL.
Add 0.1 mM PMSF and protease inhibitor cocktail to the diluted extract.
Transfer 3 ml of amylose resin to a 1.5 × 12 cm polypropylene column.
Wash the column five times with 15 ml column buffer.
Load the diluted crude extract at a flow rate no more than 1.87 ml/min.
Wash the column with 36 ml of column buffer at a flow rate no more than 3.75 ml/min.
Elute the fusion protein with column buffer + 10 mM maltose and collect 15 fractions of 500 μL each.
Take 800 μg of purified protein and run on an SDS-PAGE gel.
Transfer the protein onto a membrane using the Bio-Rad Trans-Blot Turbo Transfer System.
Stain the membrane with Ponceau S.
Locate and cut out the band corresponding to your protein from the stained membrane.
De-stain the strip containing the purified protein with 1× PBS-Tween 0.1%.
Block the de-stained strip with 5% BSA in 10 ml of 1× PBS for 1 hour at 25°C.
Wash the strip 5 times with 10 ml of 1× PBS-Tween 0.1% by shaking.
Incubate the strip with the antibody serum for 16 hours at 4°C.
Remove the serum from the rabbit antibody preparation.
Wash the strip twice with 10 mL 1× PBS-Tween 0.1% for 5 minutes each time.
Wash the strip twice with 10 mL 1× PBS for 5 minutes each time.
Measure the optical density of the last wash at A280 to ensure it is below 0.1.
Collect 11 elutions of purified antibody bound to the strip with 0.2 M glycine pH 2.6 in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Neutralize the glycine solution with 1 M Tris pH 8.0 buffer.
Wash the strip three times with 1× PBS for 5 minutes each time and store samples at -20°C for further use.
Store the elutions at -20°C until use.
Resuspend the Dynabeads protein A in a vial.
Transfer 50 μL (1.5 mg) of Dynabeads protein A into a 2 mL low-binding protein Eppendorf tube for each immunoprecipitation, place on the magnet and discard the supernatant.
Wash the Dynabeads three times with 200 μL 1× PBS+1 mM PMSF.
Incubate the Dynabeads with the purified antibodies for 16 h at 60 rpm rotation at 4°C.
Grind 1 g plant material in liquid nitrogen in a pre-chilled mortar to a fine powder.
Resuspend the ground plant material in 500 μL extraction buffer A or B.
Incubate the suspension on ice for 30 minutes with vortexing every 5 minutes.
Prepare extraction buffer immediately before use and store at 4°C.
Store IP buffer at 20°C–25°C according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Store NaCl at 20°C–25°C for up to 28 days.
Store DL-dithiothreitol (DTT) at 4°C for 1 year or indefinitely at −20°C in dark conditions.
Store MG132 at −20°C for up to 1 year.
Store cOmplete, EDTA-free protease inhibitor cocktail tablets dry at 4°C; stock solutions can be stored at 4°C for 1–2 weeks or at −20°C for at least 12 weeks.
Store phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride at −20°C for at least two years.
Centrifuge the sample at 11,200 × g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Collect the supernatant and transfer it to a fresh Eppendorf tube.
Quantify total protein from the lysate using a protein assay.
Wash twice the Dynabeads-Ab complex with 1× PBS + 1 mM PMSF during 5 minutes each time at 4°C.
Incubate the Dynabeads-Ab complex with 500 μL (1.5 mg) of lysate for 3 hours at 4°C in rotation.
Keep 100 μL of the lysate for input.
Wash the Dynabeads-Ab complex three times with 200 μL washing buffer 1 for 5 minutes each time at 4°C.
Wash the Dynabeads-Ab-Ag complex once with 200 μL washing buffer 2 in rotation at 30 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Place the Dynabeads-Ab-Ag complex on the magnet.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend in 35 μL of 1.5× sample buffer.
Boil at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Place the Dynabeads-Ab-Ag complex on the magnet again.
Recover the supernatant in a fresh Eppendorf tube.
Store samples at -80°C until immunoblotting or mass spectrometry analysis.
Keep 100 μl of lysis sample for control use in the experiment.
